_comment: Checked-in capability policy for the cross-SDK suite (read by orchestrator/test_runner.py).
Every capability a scenario lists under `requires` must appear in `capabilities`, and every SDK
must classify every capability as either `required` (the wrapper MUST advertise it as true; a
false/missing value fails the run and the gated scenarios still execute) or a reviewed
`unsupported` exception with a one-line reason (the gated scenarios are skipped). A capability
that is neither, or an SDK with no entry here, fails closed. Extra keys a wrapper returns from
/capabilities that are not listed in `capabilities` are ignored. Required entries are pinned by
evidence (passing CI lanes), not auto-enrolled from whatever a wrapper currently reports.
When an SDK gains support for an excepted capability, move it from `unsupported` to `required`.

capabilities.omittedTargetingRefresh: audience removal and audience-string edits on refresh re-evaluate cached assignments on next access independently of empty assignmentRules encoding, advertised from a behavioral self-test
capabilities.switchback: R33 cluster-defined switchback serving (ordered switchbackClusters, switchbackClusterValues) through a context, plus POST /switchback/assign and /switchback/permutation, advertised from a behavioral self-test
capabilities.diagnostics: POST /diagnostic hashUnit, computed by the SDK's own hashing
capabilities.diagnosticsUtf8: POST /diagnostic utf8Bytes, computed by the SDK's own UTF-8 encoder
capabilities.publishFail: POST /context/{id}/publishFail arms a one-shot publisher failure
capabilities.variableKeysMap: POST /context/{id}/variableKeysMap returns every experiment per variable key
capabilities.globalCustomFieldKeys: POST /context/{id}/globalCustomFieldKeys returns the union of custom field keys
capabilities.readyError: POST /context/{id}/readyError reports the error of a failed context
capabilities.holdouts: two-arm holdout resolution, advertised from a behavioral self-test
capabilities.holdout_arms: three-arm holdout resolution, advertised from a behavioral self-test
capabilities.assignmentRules: custom assignment rules: an experiment's assignmentRules string is evaluated and a matching rule wins with a ruleOverride:true exposure (advertised from a behavioral self-test)
capabilities.semverOperators: semver_eq/gt/gte/lt/lte operators in audience filters, compared numerically and locale-independently (advertised from a behavioral self-test)
capabilities.numericUnitIds: a numeric unit uid keeps its numeric JSON type end to end: getUnit/getUnits return the number the unit was set with (12345), not a stringified copy ("12345")
capabilities.publishThrowsOnFailure: a direct publish() call whose collector/transport fails surfaces the failure to the caller by throwing; the pending events are preserved and an error event is logged
capabilities.trackRejectsNonObjectProperties: track() rejects non-object goal properties (e.g. a list of pairs or an empty list) by throwing "Goal '<name>' properties must be of type object.", matching the JS reference
capabilities.refreshNoOpOnFailedContext: refresh() on a context whose initial load failed is a no-op: it does not fetch, emits no refresh or error event, the context stays failed, and data offered for the refresh is not applied (matching the JS reference)

unsupported.trackRejectsNonObjectProperties: python3-sdk#11 restored the released v0.2.4 behaviour: track() accepts a list of pairs / empty list as properties instead of throwing; reviewed Python exception to preserve backwards compatibility with v0.2.4 (scenario 39)
unsupported.refreshNoOpOnFailedContext: python3-sdk#11 restored the released v0.2.4 behaviour: refresh() recovers a context whose initial load failed (re-fetches and applies data) instead of being a no-op; reviewed Python exception to preserve backwards compatibility with v0.2.4 (scenario 229)
